content.rendered:
Sometimes the path to perfection is long and winding.

I broke down “Janey, Don’t You Lose Heart” last spring, and at the time I noted that we can trace the melody and lyrics of this 1983 track to a home demo called “True Love Is Hard to Come By” recorded a year earlier.

But we can go even farther back still: Here’s a home demo that goes all the way back to the early days of the River sessions.

We’ll call it “Every Day and Every Night,” because those are the only lyrics in the entire song. But it’s not the lyrics we’re interested in here–it’s the melody. For those of us who love Bruce’s 1985 “Janey” B-side, this early work in progress should sound very familiar.

Every Day and Every Night
Recorded: Early 1979 (demo only)
Never released
Never performed

© November 17, 2019

excerpt.rendered: “Janey, Don’t You Lose Heart” traces its origins to this 1979 home demo.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Janey, Don’t You Lose Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One of Bruce's lightest but truest songs of love and friendship, "Janey, Don't You Lose Heart" is an instant highlight wherever she turns up.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: True Love Is Hard to Come By
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A fascinating work-in-progress that eventually led to "Janey, Don't You Lose Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Jesse Malin: Janey, Don’t You Lose Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Jesse Malin and friends gave us a lovely cover of one Bruce's lighter tracks, from Light of Day 2017.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Love and Kisses
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: This early River-era home demo was a dead end, but it's melody pointed the way to an officially released Born in the U.S.A. outtake.

jetpack-related-posts.title: I Don’t Know
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce recorded a home demo of "I Don't Know" in 1979. What's it about? Like the song says...

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Summer Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Summer Night" is one for the completists--a Nebraska-era home demo with a lovely melody but mostly bluffed lyrics.
